tower.prices.bands: Bands: how far apart two zones are

Worst first. The shops’ own fees, our fee and the tax are not in either column. Planned at estimated distances until real road distances are kept.

tower.hold.title: Payment held: a problem reported
tower.hold.lede: A person paid first, the load was delivered, and a problem was reported within 24 hours, so the driver’s pay waits here. Read the record side by side; the protocol answers three questions from it. Apply what it says with one tap. Going against it takes a reason and a second member of staff.

tower.codes.title: Sign-in codes
tower.codes.lede: The ways a sign-in code reaches a phone. A code goes by the first route that is set up and on. If that route cannot take it, or leaves it undelivered for {s} seconds, the code goes by the next. Change the order per country, or switch a route off.

For delivery reports, set this webhook address in Meta with your verify token: {address}, and put WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET and WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN in the settings.
